title: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976.
full_text: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 197728 Act Number: 28 Enactment Date: 1977-05-09 Act Year: 1977 Short Title: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Act, 1976. Long Title: An Act to unify, consolidate and amend the laws relating to housing, repairing and reconstructing dangerous buildings and carrying out improvement works in slum areas.
